page.overview:
Who is Ben Crankleshaft?

Ben Crankleshaft is a minor character in Cars. He is a Northernstar semi-hauler that often settles down for the night at the Top Down Truck Stop.

"Ben considers the open road his home, fellow truckers his family, and the Top Down Truck Stop his dining room. He has few close buddies, but can make friends in every town he passes through. Once Ben's met someone, he never forgets their name. He can recognize a familiar grille anywhere."
